templates.title: Molten Forge
templates.blurb: A volcanic caldera at night — cracked obsidian crater spilling rivers of molten lava, ember sparks on the heat, ash smoke rolling into a red-black sky. Click the crater for a controlled eruption pulse. Fully procedural, pure atmosphere.
templates.prompt: Molten ForgeCreate from scratch a fully interactive 3D scene of a VOLCANIC CALDERA at night: a cracked obsidian crater spilling rivers of molten lava down a black mountainside, ember sparks rising on the heat, ash smoke rolling into a starless red-black sky. The style should be cinematic and stylized — a premium 3D artwork with painterly glow, not a photoreal simulation. Start from a blank page; do not reuse any previous project.DELIVERY- One final standalone .html file that opens directly in a desktop browser (double-click, file://) with no internet connection. Bundle the 3D library (e.g. three.js) and all assets inline; generate textures procedurally.- The PAGE must be a complete mini-site, not a bare canvas: html lang=en, a non-empty title, a meta name=description (10+ chars), one h1 hero headline, at least one button and one real anchor link as CTAs, a top nav bar with the brand, and a footer credit line. All page text sits in an HTML chrome overlay above the canvas (canvas pointer-events:none, chrome interactive elements pointer-events:auto). Inside the 3D scene itself keep text out - no readable words on signs or objects, abstract shapes only. Keep the copy short and purposeful: what this site is FOR, and one clear next action.SKY AND ATMOSPHERE- Near-black sky graded from deep charcoal at the zenith to a bruised red-orange glow hugging the horizon, lit from below by the lava.- No stars: the air is thick with suspended ash; faint drifting ash flakes catch the ember light.- A slow-breathing column of smoke and gas rises from the crater vent, curling with domain-warped noise, lit warm-orange at its base and cooling to grey-violet as it climbs.VOLCANIC MOUNTAIN (detailed terrain, no primitive-looking cone)- A broad shield-volcano massif with a sunken caldera at the summit; jagged rim walls with overhanging ledges and cooled black lava shelves.- Radial gullies and buttresses down the flanks; a foreground ridge of sharp aa-lava blocks framing the bottom of the shot; distant lower cones as silhouettes for depth.- Terrain material: matte black basalt with plate-like AO, warm rim-light where it faces the lava, darker in the crevices; a heat-haze shimmer gradient near the vent.THE LAVA (the hero — layered glow technique)- A glowing crater lake at the summit: a slowly churning emissive surface with a dark cooling crust that tears apart as it drifts, revealing hotter magma beneath (scrolling noise on an emissive shader).- Two or three lava flows winding down separate gullies: each a ribbon of emissive orange-yellow core wrapped in a darker crust, with brighter molten threads crawling along its edges.- The glow must read in layers, the way professional magma shaders do: hot emissive core (yellow-white), an aura of orange bloom around it, an outer diffuse red glow bleeding onto the surrounding rock, and a soft heat distortion where the air meets the flow. Use an emissive shader plus an additive glow layer — not just a bright solid color.- Lava texture scrolls downstream at different speeds per flow; the crust pattern regenerates so it never visibly tiles.EMBERS, SPARKS, SMOKE- Hundreds of ember particles lift off the crater and the hottest flow edges: they start orange-white, cool to red, then fade to black ash as they rise on a thermal updraft, swaying on wind curl-noise. Instanced or point sprites — cheap and abundant.- Occasional burst-sparks pop from the crater with a brief flare.- Ground-hugging smoke wisps slide along the lower flanks, half-lit from beneath.LIGHT AND CAMERA- The lava itself is the main light: warm point/area lights along the flows tint the rock. A cool faint rim from a high hidden source keeps the mountain silhouette readable against the sky.- Slow cinematic camera drift orbiting a few degrees with a gentle breathing dolly; wide establishing framing by default — caldera at the top of frame, foreground lava ridge anchoring the bottom third.MOTION AND INTERACTION- Pointer parallax: moving the pointer sways the camera a few degrees; on touch, drag does the same.- Click / tap the crater: a controlled eruption pulse — the crater flares bright, a shockwave ring of light races down the flows, a burst of embers erupts, then everything settles back over ~3 seconds. Brief, elegant, self-resuming on idle — a dramatic accent, not a screen-shake game effect.- prefers-reduced-motion: keep the full static composition and slow lava scroll; stop camera drift and eruption auto-pulse.PERFORMANCE- Clamp devicePixelRatio <= 2; particle counts scale down on narrow viewports; handle resize; no horizontal scroll at 390px; pointer and touch input work; zero console errors and warnings.

templates.title: Aurora Ridge
templates.blurb: An arctic night under a living aurora borealis — curtains of green and violet light rippling across a star-filled polar sky, bouncing on wind-carved snow drifts and a frozen pond. Pointer proximity stirs the nearest curtain. Fully procedural, pure atmosphere.
templates.prompt: Aurora RidgeCreate from scratch a fully interactive 3D scene of an ARCTIC NIGHT: a snow-covered ridge under a living aurora borealis — curtains of green and violet light rippling across a star-filled polar sky, their colors bouncing on the ice and snow below. Cinematic, stylized, premium; not a photoreal weather sim. Start from a blank page; do not reuse any previous project.DELIVERY- One final standalone .html file that opens directly in a desktop browser (double-click, file://) with no internet connection. Bundle the 3D library (e.g. three.js) and all assets inline; generate textures procedurally.- The PAGE must be a complete mini-site, not a bare canvas: html lang=en, a non-empty title, a meta name=description (10+ chars), one h1 hero headline, at least one button and one real anchor link as CTAs, a top nav bar with the brand, and a footer credit line. All page text sits in an HTML chrome overlay above the canvas (canvas pointer-events:none, chrome interactive elements pointer-events:auto). Inside the 3D scene itself keep text out - no readable words on signs or objects, abstract shapes only. Keep the copy short and purposeful: what this site is FOR, and one clear next action.SKY AND STARS- Deep indigo-to-black night sky; dense crisp starfield with varied magnitudes, a faint milky-way band, and the occasional slow meteor that streaks and fades.- Thin high cloud haze that catches a hint of aurora color — kept subtle so the aurora stays the star.THE AURORA (the hero — domain-warped light ribbons)- Multiple overlapping curtains of aurora light: tall vertical drapes that fold and ripple along the horizon, each curtain following its own slow domain-warped noise path so they never move in sync.- Physically inspired color layering, the way real aurora photos look: the dominant green band (oxygen emission, ~100 km up) as the body of each curtain; a rare crimson-red glow at the very top of the tallest curtains; and a delicate pink-violet fringe along the ragged bottom edge of the drape (nitrogen emission). Colors blend smoothly — no hard stripes.- The curtains are semi-transparent additive light: they brighten where folds overlap and thin out to wisps at ragged edges. A gentle vertical shimmer runs inside each curtain; the whole formation slowly advances across the sky over minutes, not seconds.- Implement as layered shaders (domain-warped noise ribbons + fbm) on tall additive-blended curtain planes — the technique used by polished aurora scenes, not a scrolling gradient texture.SNOW RIDGE AND ICE- A foreground snow ridge with wind-carved drifts and sastrugi, a few exposed dark rocks breaking through the crust, and a frozen pond / ice slab in the mid-ground with a glassy sheen.- Snow material: cool blue-white base, soft subsurface feel, fine sparkle glints that twinkle as the view angle changes (cheap sparkle noise keyed to view + light).- The snow and ice catch the aurora: a soft green-violet bounce light shifts across the drifts as the curtains brighten and move overhead; the frozen pond mirrors a blurred smear of the brightest curtain.- Distant mountain silhouettes as low-contrast layered planes against the sky for depth.A SMALL HUMAN TOUCH (scale anchor)- A tiny warm-lit cabin at the mid-distance on the ridge: one small window glowing warm amber, a thin chimney plume that rises, bends on the wind, and dissolves. Its warm light pools on the nearby snow — a cozy counterpoint to the cold sky.LIGHT AND CAMERA- Moonlight is faint and cool from behind the camera; the aurora is the event, gently tinting everything.- Slow cinematic drift: a gentle pan across the ridge with a subtle breathing dolly. Wide framing — aurora fills the upper two-thirds, ridge anchors the lower third.MOTION AND INTERACTION- Pointer parallax: moving the pointer sways the camera a few degrees; on touch, drag does the same.- Pointer proximity "stirs" the aurora: when the cursor nears the sky region, the nearest curtain brightens and ripples a little more lively, then relaxes — subtle and magical, not a spotlight.- Occasional meteor streaks across the sky, every so often, with a faint trail.- prefers-reduced-motion: keep the full composition and slow curtain shimmer; stop camera drift and meteors.PERFORMANCE- Clamp devicePixelRatio <= 2; curtain/shader cost scales down on narrow viewports; handle resize; no horizontal scroll at 390px; pointer and touch input work; zero console errors and warnings.

templates.title: Neon Alley
templates.blurb: A rain-slicked cyberpunk alley at night — dense neon signage in strict pink/cyan palette, heavy rain streaking down, puddles mirroring the glow with live ripple shaders. Click a puddle for a neon-flare ripple. Fully procedural, pure atmosphere.
templates.prompt: Neon AlleyCreate from scratch a fully interactive 3D scene of a RAIN-SLICKED CYBERPUNK ALLEY at night: a narrow street canyon between stacked buildings, dense neon signage, heavy rain streaking down, puddles on the asphalt mirroring the glow. Cinematic and stylized — premium cyberpunk mood, not a game level. Start from a blank page; do not reuse any previous project.DELIVERY- One final standalone .html file that opens directly in a desktop browser (double-click, file://) with no internet connection. Bundle the 3D library (e.g. three.js) and all assets inline; generate textures procedurally.- The PAGE must be a complete mini-site, not a bare canvas: html lang=en, a non-empty title, a meta name=description (10+ chars), one h1 hero headline, at least one button and one real anchor link as CTAs, a top nav bar with the brand, and a footer credit line. All page text sits in an HTML chrome overlay above the canvas (canvas pointer-events:none, chrome interactive elements pointer-events:auto). Inside the 3D scene itself keep text out - no readable words on signs or objects, abstract shapes only. Keep the copy short and purposeful: what this site is FOR, and one clear next action. Neon signs may carry abstract glyph shapes / stylized logomarks only — never readable words.COLOR DISCIPLINE (the soul of the shot)- Strict palette: hot magenta-pink, electric cyan, and a sparing acid-yellow, floating on a deep blue-black world. No other hues — no green, no orange, no red except a rare single accent sign. The restraint is what makes it read premium instead of toy-store neon.- Deep blue-black is the base: sky, building mass, asphalt. The neon is the only saturated light.STREET AND BUILDINGS (a canyon, not a box)- A narrow alley receding to a hazy vanishing point: stacked modular facades on both sides — balconies, AC units, cable bundles, awnings, pipes, fire escapes — silhouetted hard against the glow.- Wet asphalt with a visible crown and gutter; scattered debris (crates, a tipped bin, loose cables) breaking the ground plane.- Volumetric haze / steam: vents breathe slow plumes that catch the neon color; the distant end of the alley dissolves into fog.NEON SIGNS (the light sources, procedurally drawn)- Many signs: vertical kanji-style abstract glyph strips, boxed signs, tube outlines, marquee dots, logo emblems — all drawn procedurally onto canvases (shapes, strokes, glowing borders — abstract marks only, never readable text).- Each sign is bound to its own colored point light so the wall behind it and the puddle below receive that exact hue.- Healthy dysfunction: a few signs buzz and flicker on their own random cadence; one or two are dead-dark; one big sign occasionally sputters back to life. A couple of slow pink↔cyan color-cycle signs keep the frame alive.- Pooled dynamic lights only — a fixed small budget of real lights recycled across the brightest signs; everything else fakes its glow with emissive + baked vertex tint so performance stays clean.PUDDLES AND RAIN (the wet soul)- Several irregular puddle shapes in the asphalt, each a live shader: ripples expanding from raindrop impacts (staggered timing), with the neon signage smeared and swirling inside the reflection (ripple normal-distorts the reflected color; neon swirls as rings pass through).- A gentle continuous rain: thousands of instanced thin streaks falling with a slight wind slant, catching neon as they pass lit zones — brighter streaks near signs, faint ones in shadow. Streak length reads as motion, not dots.- Splash micro-bursts where streaks hit puddles, timed with the ripple shader.- Rain intensity breathes slowly: heavier for a while, easing to a drizzle, then building again.LIGHT AND CAMERA- The neon is the only real light; a cool ambient blue-black fill keeps building mass readable.- Slow cinematic drift down the alley (a few degrees of sway, gentle dolly); wide framing with the vanishing point slightly off-center (rule of thirds).MOTION AND INTERACTION- Pointer parallax: the camera sways a few degrees; on touch, drag does the same.- Pointer movement: the nearest sign to the pointer axis does a brief satisfying pulse (brightens and its light kicks), as if your presence energizes it.- Click / tap a puddle: a strong ripple ring bursts from that point with a brief neon flare in the reflection, then settles.- prefers-reduced-motion: keep the full composition, slow sign flicker and reflections; stop camera drift and rain-motion (static streaks, no ripples).PERFORMANCE- Clamp devicePixelRatio <= 2; on narrow viewports scale pixel ratio down and thin the rain streak count (the technique that keeps heavy cyberpunk scenes smooth on mobile); handle resize; no horizontal scroll at 390px; pointer and touch input work; zero console errors and warnings.

templates.title: PulseOps
templates.blurb: A live observability dashboard as the hero — streaming sparklines, pulsing metric cards, honest numbers, and one clear call to action. Zero deps, one HTML file.
templates.prompt: PulseOps Build a single-file SaaS landing page (one index.html, no build step) for an observability product. Dark base (#070b14), cyan accent (#4cc9f0), full-viewport canvas background drawing live streaming sparklines and pulsing metric cards (canvas 2D, no libraries). Above it: a nav with brand + 'Get a demo' CTA, an eyebrow ('Observability · Metrics · Traces · Logs'), an h1 ('See every signal. Fix it before users notice.'), a supporting paragraph, and a features grid (1.2M events/sec, <400ms p99 query, one-line agent, alert routing). Include a 'The brief' toggle panel (hidden by default, opens on button click) explaining the template's purpose, and a footer credit line. The background must answer the scroll with gentle parallax on the sparklines. Every claim gets a concrete number. Make it feel like a premium DevOps brand, not a generic startup page.

templates.title: Aether
templates.blurb: A scroll-driven product story — living generative gradient orbs answer your scroll, chapters fade in and lift, one action stays in reach the whole way down. Zero deps, one HTML file.
templates.prompt: Aether Build a single-file scroll-driven product story (one index.html, no build step) with three full-viewport chapters. Full-viewport canvas background draws 7 generative gradient orbs (radial gradients, additive blending, gentle drift) that shift vertically with scroll depth. Each chapter is a <section> that fades in and lifts via IntersectionObserver when it enters the viewport; chapters use distinct accent colors (violet #b388ff, teal #64ffda, coral #ff8a65). Above the canvas: a fixed nav with brand + 'Start a project' CTA, a 'The brief' toggle panel, and a footer credit. Chapter 1: eyebrow 'Chapter 01 — The Idea', h1 'A product story that scrolls like a film.', supporting copy, CTA buttons. Chapter 2: 'Chapter 02 — The Build', three-move feature grid. Chapter 3: 'Chapter 03 — The Proof', three concrete number cards (14 days, +38% dwell, 1 file), closing CTA. Keep copy short so the motion carries the narrative. Premium editorial feel, not a generic startup page.

templates.title: Robot Foundry
templates.blurb: A free generative toy — procedural robot heads drawn from a seed on canvas, one-click randomize, SVG download, shareable seed code. A lead-magnet free template.
templates.prompt: Robot Foundry Build a single-file generative robot-head toy (one index.html, no build step) as a free-tier lead magnet. Dark base (#0a0d12), three fixed accent colors (amber #ffd166, cyan #4cc9f0, pink #f06292). Full-viewport canvas draws a procedurally generated robot head from a numeric seed: rounded/square/hexagonal head shape, 2-4 antenna variants, four eye styles (visor bar, twin dots, hollow rounds, thin bar), four mouth styles (grille with pink slots, smile arc, straight line, none), optional side ear panels, and a slow scan-line sweep. Every part drawn from a seeded PRNG (mulberry32) so the same seed reproduces the same face. Above the canvas: a nav with brand + 'Download SVG' CTA, an eyebrow ('Free generative toy · procedural · no assets'), an h1 ('Forge a robot head. Every seed is a new face.'), a seed-code display line, 'Randomize' / 'Download SVG' / 'The brief' buttons, a three-card feature grid (Procedural, SVG export, Shareable), a hidden 'The brief' toggle panel, and a footer credit. The SVG export must be a valid standalone vector file that scales. Keep it playful but premium — a toy that makes people smile and share the seed code.
